div.ab: "In the name of God. First: I am Damianos, son of Kosmas, of Pagi of Pyam. I have written for Shenouti, son of Elias of Pyam City. See, I urged (?) you. You promised in my behalf (?). You got a half solidus for me on loan. I spent it for corn for my children. I am ready to satisfy you in regard to it by the 1st of Parmouti. For you have done me a kindness, and have heeded the cry of my children. I shall return it to its place, with my thanks, without disagreement. Written the month of Choiak 6th, 13th, of the indiction. I, Apater, the leitourgos of Pagi, I am witness. I, Papa Ale, I am witness. By me, Paul, son of Theod."

listBibl.bibl: Worrell WH, PMich Coptic III, 19, 1942, Pl VI
